articles.title: Ask HN: How to deal with just being a PR reviewer for LLMs nowadays
articles.title_ja: Ask HN: How to deal with just being a PR reviewer for LLMs nowadays
articles.summary_ja:
Title: Ask HN: How to deal with just being a PR reviewer for LLMs nowadays
HN text: I know .. architecture is important and yes it is also fun to figure it out, but apart from that all that was fun for me is done by AI nowadays and I am basically a PR reviewer for Claude now. And I hate it. I am looking at a terminal window half of the day and have to figure out what the LLM wants to do ... depending on much Anthropic nervs the model, this can be easy or it still invents words and I have to check every detail. My brain feels like it is getting cooked after a couple of hours, but the work day is only half done. How do you guys deal with this?

HN text: The AI Hub provides 91 curated lesson plans teaching middle and high school students about AI - how it works, what the risks and benefits of AI are, and how it is impacting society.
